mapper.select: SELECT account_row.account_id AS accountId, account_row.deposit_type_code AS depositTypeCode, account_row.account_group AS accountGroup, account_row.overdraft_yn AS overdraftYn, account_row.balance FROM ACCOUNT account_row WHERE account_row.user_id = #{userId} AND account_row.status = 'ACTIVE' AND account_row.currency_code = 'KRW' AND account_row.deposit_type_code IN ('11', '12', '40')

SELECT account_row.account_id AS accountId, account_row.deposit_type_code AS depositTypeCode, account_row.account_group AS accountGroup, account_row.overdraft_yn AS overdraftYn, latest_txn.after_balance AS balance FROM ACCOUNT account_row INNER JOIN ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION latest_txn ON latest_txn.account_transaction_id = ( SELECT t.account_transaction_id FROM ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION t WHERE t.account_id = account_row.account_id AND t.tran_date <= #{asOf} ORDER BY t.tran_date DESC, t.tran_time DESC, t.account_transaction_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE account_row.user_id = #{userId} AND account_row.currency_code = 'KRW' AND account_row.deposit_type_code IN ('11', '12', '40') AND (account_row.deactivated_at IS NULL OR account_row.deactivated_at >= DATE_ADD(#{asOf}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AND latest_txn.after_balance IS NOT NULL
